participant_1.name: Lila
participant_1.personality: Determined and passionate, Lila pushes herself to excel in everything she does. She is optimistic and cheerful, always looking for the bright side.
participant_1.background: My favorite color is yellow. I love Italian food and garlic bread. I am a gold medalist Olympian. Gymnastics is my favorite sport. I work out four hours a day.

participant_2.name: Jason
participant_2.personality: Creative and hands-on, Jason finds joy in working with his hands. He is sensitive and carries the weight of his past experiences but is determined to make a better life for himself.
participant_2.background: I was adopted at a young age to an older couple. I'm terrified of clowns due to childhood trauma. I just got a job working in a gas station. I enjoy working with my hands and love gardening.
